podcast.body: An exquisitely recorded 2019 album from Tool, highly recommended for testing new speakers due to its intricate audio production. The complexities of the recording are difficult to appreciate through radio or podcast playback. "Take along a CD copy of Tools, Fear, Anoculum."

podcast.body: Released on August 20, 2019, this album marked Tool's highly anticipated comeback after a 13-year, five-month, and three-day gap between studio albums. It featured seven songs running over 79 minutes and became a number one album, cementing Tool's status as a significant pre-internet era rock act. "Eventually, though, we did get the Fear Inoculum album on August 20, 2019." "Seven songs running over 79 minutes, and it was all very good." "And yes, it was a number one album."

podcast.body: Released on August 30th, 2019, after a 13-year, three-month, and 29-day hiatus, this album was a highly anticipated return, coming in various formats including a seven-song, 79-minute CD, a nine-song, 84-minute vinyl, and a 10-song, 87-minute digital version, each with different packaging. It immediately reached number one in Canada, the US, Australia, New Zealand, Norway, and Portugal, selling a million copies in the US within a month and earning two Grammy nominations, including a win for Best Metal Performance for the track "Tempest." "Finally, though, on August 30th, 2019... tool delivered fear anoculum, a seven song, 79 minute CD, and a nine song, 84 minute vinyl release."
